people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
translations.bsb: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person —and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
